validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION: real and correctly classified. This is the segment name itself confirming identity: gem.wiki's own citation ecoportal.kz/Public/PubHearings/LoadFile/28485 (the project's EIA 'Poyasnitel'naya zapiska', dated 2020-12-12, a primary government permitting/design document, 3.6MB PDF -- pdftotext -layout was needed, the raw text-search screen is a known false negative on PDFs this size, matching url_verifier.py's own documented 'LARGE PDFs' caveat) literally titles the project 'Variant stroitel'stva 3-nitki gazoprovoda-otvoda "KS-14 - gorod Aktobe"' -- i.e. the THIRD LATERAL/BRANCH off compressor station 14 of the Bukhara-Ural trunk line, feeding Aktobe city -- an exact match for segment_name 'CS 14-Aktobe III'. It documents Variant-1 (720mm/4.6MPa) was the option actually SELECTED ('vybor Varianta-1... soglasovan s Zakazchikom'), with linear-part length 165.038 km and annual capacity 2.4 bcm/y at that pressure -- exact matches to GEM's LengthKnown=165.00km, Diameter=720mm, PressureUnits/Pressure=4.60MPa and Capacity=2.40 bcm/y. Intergas.kz/ru/about-company/ independently confirms MG 'Bukhara-Ural' is operated by Intergas Central Asia's UMG Aktobe department, and that Intergas Central Asia is itself part of ('vkhodit v sostav') NC QazaqGaz JSC -- corroborating both the parent-pipeline attribution and Owner1=QazaqGaz. SPEC: independently confirmed via TWO distinct origins that agree -- (1) the 2020 ecoportal.kz EIA/design PDF above, and (2) the akimat Aktobe press-service wire issued at the 2023-07-21 groundbreaking ceremony in Khromtau district (this ONE press release was independently republished, with identical figures, by aktobetimes.kz, kapital.kz and khabar.kz -- counted as ONE origin per the same-wire-story rule, not three): length 165 km, annual capacity 2.4 bcm/y, cost ~43 bn KZT, ceremony held in Khromtau district (matches StartPrefecture/District). An earlier gazeta.uz piece (2023-02-27, quoting the akim at a distinct February briefing) gave a preliminary 162km/~43bn-tenge estimate -- a normal pre-construction-vs-at-groundbreaking refinement, not a material conflict with the 165km figure GEM carries. SegmentCost=43,400,000,000 KZT (2024) is consistent with this trajectory: ~43bn (Feb 2023 estimate) -> ~43bn (July 2023 groundbreaking) -> 43.1bn (diapazon.kz, 2024-09-07, PSD/contractor TOO 'Otau-Story', planned SMR finish Nov 2024, throughput 526,500 m3/h) -> 43.4bn (2024, GEM's figure) -- steady upward refinement across three dated, independent readings, not an error. DUPLICATE: checked against the full 11-pipeline KZ-gas roster -- no other row names Bukhara-Ural, KS-14, or an Aktobe-area lateral; no duplicate. CAVEAT (why not a clean pass): the current_ref on ConstructionYear/ConstructionMonth, StartYear1, Capacity and LengthKnown is gurk.kz/news/stroitelstvo-gazoprovoda-buhara-ural-idet-intensivno, which is CONFIRMED DEAD (HTTP 404, on the orchestrator's confirmed-genuine-deletion list, re-verified live in this pass) -- a legitimate drop per the once-working-ref rule, not just an access failure. Filed as fills-style ref replacements below (see validity proposed_refs) rather than value changes, since none of the underlying values are wrong.
